LONG_ONLY.name: LONG_ONLY

data.coverage_policy: vendor_response; BTC maximum eight-hour gap with one-second boundary jitter
data.timestamp_policy: minute boundary; vendor jitter <=1000ms retained in raw settled_at

limits: Two alternative scenarios, not joint capital.
Observed M1+fill extrema, not intraminute MFE/MAE.
N100 is operational preliminary, not power.

SHORT_BOOK.name: SHORT_BOOK

data.coverage_policy: vendor_response; BTC maximum eight-hour gap with one-second boundary jitter
data.timestamp_policy: minute boundary; vendor jitter <=1000ms retained in raw settled_at

limits: Two alternative scenarios, not joint capital.
Observed M1+fill extrema, not intraminute MFE/MAE.

LONG_ONLY.interpretation: Entry identity is origin+signal_at+opened_at, not outcome or nearest time. Dollars depend on each scenario's path/quota; new-trade sum is descriptive and not causal incremental book gain.
